paite: Huan Samuel in Israel mi tengteng kiang ah, "Ngai dih ua, ka kiang a na thugen tengteng uh ngaikhia in, na tung uah kumpipa ka bawlta hi.
heading: Samuel In Mipite Kiang Ah Thu Agen

paite: Tu in, ngai dih ua, kumpipa in na ma uh akai hi. Kei zaw tek in ka sam leng akangta hi. Ngai dih ua, na kiang uah ka tapate a-om uh. Ka naupan a pan tutan na ma uh ka hon pi hi.

Hiai ah ka om hi. TOUPA ma leh asathau nilhpa ma ah hon sel un. Kua bawngtal ka suh ngei a? Kua sabiltung ahia ka suh ngei? Kua ka khem ngei a? Kua ka hihgenthei ngei a? Ka mit tawsak ding in kua a pan in golhna ka la ngei a? K'on din nawn vek ding," achi hi.
Amau, "Na hon khem ngei kei a, n'on hihgenthei ngei sam kei. Kuamah khut a pan lak tuak louh leng na la ngei kei," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka khut ah bangmah kilawm lou na mu kei uh, chih tuni in TOUPA na lak uah theihpihpa ahi a; asathau nilhpa atheipihpa ahi," achi hi. Amau, "Amah hon theipihpa ahi," achi uhi.
Samuel in mite kiang ah, "Mosi leh Aaron seppa leh Aigupta a pan na pipute uh pikhepa TOUPA ahi.
Huchi in dingh kinken unla, TOUPA ma ah TOUPA'N na tung uh leh na pipute uh tung a thil dik ana hihte ka hon sutpih ding.
Aigupta gam a Jakob alut nung in, na pipute un TOUPA asam ua, huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron asawl hi. Na pipute uh Aigupta gam a pan apikhia a, hiai mun ah atengsak hi.
Himahleh, TOUPA a Pathian uh amangngilh uh. Ama'n Hazor sepaih heutu Sisera khut, Philistia mite khut leh Moab kumpipa khut ah akhawng a, amaute'n adou uhi.
"TOUPA asam ua, 'TOUPA i lehngatsan ua, Baal leh Ashtaroth nna i sep ziak un i na khialta uh. Himahleh tu in ka melmate khut a pan hon hunkhia inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh,' achi uh.
TOUPA'N Jerubbaal, Bendan, Jephthah leh Samuel asawl a, khat lam khat lam a na melmate uh khut a pan ahon hunkhia hi. Huchi in bittak in na tengta uhi.
Ammon suante kumpipa Nahash nou dou ding in ahong kuan chih na theihtak un, ka kiang ah, 'Ahi kei, kumpi in ka tung uah vaihawm hen' na chi uh; TOUPA Pathian lah na kumpipa uh ahi gige ngal a.
"Huchi in na kumpipa tel uleh nget uh en dih uh, TOUPA'N kumpipa ahon bawlsakta hi.
TOUPA laudan na siam ua, a-nna na sep ua, a-aw na zuih ua, TOUPA thupiak na helsan louh ua, nou leh na tung ua vaihawm kumpipa toh TOUPA na Pathian uh zuite na hih uleh ahoih ding hi.
Himahleh, TOUPA aw zui lou a, TOUPA thupiak na helsan uleh na pipute un ToUPA khut athuak mah bang un nou leng na thuak ding uhi.
Huchi in ding kinken unla, TOUPA'N na mitmuh ua thil thupitak ahih ding en un.

Tuni in huit buh ala uh ahi kei maw? Van gingsak ding leh vuah zusak ding in TOUPA ka sam ding. Huchi in kumpipa na nget thu uah TOUPA mitmuh a thil na hihkhelh uh athupidan thei in na mu ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Samuel in TOUPA asam a, TOUPA'N huai ni in van agingsak a, vuah azusak hi. Huchi in mite'n TOUPA leh Samuel alau mahmah uhi.

Mi tengteng in Samuel kiang ah, "Ka sihlouhna ding un, TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah na sikhate hon thumsak in. Hiai thil hoih loutak, kumpipa ka na nget uh, ka gitlouhna tengteng uh behlap ka na hita uh," achi uhi.
Samuel in mite kiang ah, "Lau kei un, hiai thil giloutak na hihta uhi. Himahleh TOUPA na zuih uh pialsan kei unla, na lungtang tengteng un TOUPA nna sem zaw un.
"Lampial kei un. Manna bei thilte leh nou hon hunkhe theiloute zui kei un; amaute bangmah lou ahi ngal ua.
Amin thupitak ziak in TOUPA'N amite alehngatsan kei dia; amah mite hi ding a noute hon bawl TOUPA kipah lam ahi.
Huai phet leng ahi kei a, nou a dia thum tawp in TOUPA tung ah thil ka hihkhial het kei ding. Himahleh lampi hoih leh dik ka hon kawkmuh zaw ding ahi.
TOUPA laudan siam photphot un. Na lungtang tengteng un chihtaktak in amah nna sem unla; nou a dia athilhih thupitakte ngaihtuah un.
Himahleh giloutak a thil na hih lailai uleh nou leh na kumpipa uh na mangthang ding uh," achi hi.
